jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (AI Product) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Principal Product Manager (AI Product) - Join Our Innovative Team at thinkcell Software   Our Story   At thinkcell, we create powerful software solutions that help professionals be more efficient and productive. Founded in 2002 and based in Berlin, our tools integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Office to help users create presentations, charts, and diagrams with ease. Our dynamic, international team values creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence.   What You Will Do   You'll co- own our AI product end-to-end, from discovery to business outcome . You'll set direction s to p roduct m anagers who each own parts of the product, while staying close to customers and internal stakeholders . With designers and engineers, you'll make sure we build the right thing s and build them well. This is a pivotal role to help execute an ambitious vision .   Key Responsibilities:   Co-own the product   Co-own our AI product end-to-end, from market research and discovery through to UAT and release together with product design and engineering Translate user needs into relevant business outcomes, not just features and products Contribute to product vision, strategy and roadmap in close partnership with leadership   Teaming   Foster an empowered team across product, design and engineering to deliver great outcomes Set direction for and coach other product managers who own parts of the product Understand and align with senior management and all other business stakeholders to ensure outcomes pay into vision and strategy   Stay close to the customer   Be the voice of the customer, advocating for user needs while balancing technical constraints and business goals Keep abreast of industry trends and competitive products so thinkcell stays ahead of the curve Use latest technology to deploy best-in-class discovery   You will be great for this position if you have   Experience: 5+ years as a product manager on software products, including a track record of mentoring or leading other PMs User-centricity: a passion for understanding user needs and translating them into impactful, efficient, and delightful products and business outcomes Technical & AI fluency: strong IT affinity, understanding of how our products are built, and familiarity with AI products and technologies (experience shipping AI-powered products a plus) Communication: outstanding communicator who partners effectively with engineering and builds compelling presentations (PowerPoint experience a plus) Resilience and adaptability: thrives under pressure, embraces evolving processes, and stays focused on delivery Language: fluent in English, written and spoken Willingness to work on-site in our Berlin office 4 days per week, with 1 remote day Our Values   As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us:   Forward Thinking : We embrace change and challenge the status quo.   Ownership : We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes.   Customer First : We prioritize delivering lasting value.   Unified Team : We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity.   Strive for Excellence : We set ambitious goals and pursue quality.   We believe in a human hiring process, every application is personally reviewed. Why is thinkcell the right place for you? We empower over 1.3 million users across 35,000 companies, including top consulting firms and major global enterprises. With offices in Berlin, Munich, Denver, Munich, London, Tokyo, and Dubai, we’re a diverse team of over 250 people, committed to innovation and excellence.   thinkcell is more than a job – it's a chance to be part of an innovative, inclusive team that values collaboration and growth. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Together, we can shape the future of productivity software. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the team!     Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Manager - Agent Experience (Fluency in French & English required)
jobs.description: Product Manager - Agent Experience  Location: Paris, France preferred, open to London applicants (hybrid, three days a week in the office) Team: Customer care Salary: €46,000 – €55,000 / £47,000 – £59,000 Language: Fluency in French & English Contract: Permanent  Reporting To: Lead Product Manager Please note:  This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities . About Kaluza Kaluza  is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What you’ll do Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes. Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced. Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live. Ensure Accessibility & Compliance: Champion EU accessibility regulations by design, translating regulatory and market-specific needs into actionable engineering requirements. Engage Clients & Drive Value: Serve as the trusted expert for clients on agent experience, advocating for platform-first configuration over bespoke builds Hands-on Delivery & Enablement: Maintain active involvement across the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC)—from agent discovery sessions to feedback loops—and produce materials to support successful client adoption. (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.) What you’ll bring Ideally, you’ll have: Contact Centre & UX Expertise: Deep experience owning end-to-end user journeys for high-frequency operational tools (e.g., agent desktops), with hands-on craft in user research, journey mapping, and usability testing with agents and supervisors. EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems. Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management. Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code. Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French. What will set you apart  Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop environments. Prior experience within SaaS platforms, the energy sector, or large-scale utility migrations. Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams. Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams. Where you'll work We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week. Our Values Five values guide how we work at Kaluza: Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale. Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes. Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say. Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego. Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives. Our Perks Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance) Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility We want the best people We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential. Come as you are We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn . Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here . jobs.title: AI Product Owner
jobs.description: About Us Creative Clicks is a leading global marketing agency with offices worldwide and 200+ professionals. Since 2009, we’ve been empowering brands, publishers, and marketers to attract and engage customers at scale with cutting-edge technology and creativity. We live by our Triple E philosophy — Energetic, Entrepreneurial, Experts — and our motto: One team. One dream. The Role We’re looking for an AI Product Owner to lead the way in turning ideas into impactful AI solutions. In this role, you’ll be the bridge between business needs, user experience, and technical execution. From ideation to delivery, you’ll own the AI product roadmap, making sure every product we launch creates measurable value, drives innovation, and is grounded in real-world usability. You’ll work hand in hand with engineers, data scientists, marketers, and commercial teams to identify opportunities, prioritize features, and bring innovative AI products to life. Key Responsibilities Define and own the AI product vision and roadmap — set priorities, milestones, and adapt as business goals and market needs evolve. Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams. Collaborate with engineers and data scientists to deliver AI-driven solutions that enhance efficiency, engagement, and outcomes. Stay ahead of AI and machine learning trends to ensure Creative Clicks is always leading innovation. Champion AI adoption across the company, driving awareness and practical application. Define and track KPIs to measure product success and business impact. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and communication across teams. Ensure compliance with data privacy, ethical AI standards, and responsible usage. What We’re Looking For You thrive where speed meets precision. You think in solutions, not problems, and feel at home in both strategy discussions and reviewing technical deliverables. Must-haves: Proven experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role (ideally with AI, data, or SaaS products). Solid understanding of AI/ML concepts and ability to translate them into business value (no coding required, but you speak the language). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience working in agile environments with cross-functional teams. Strong ability to prioritize and adapt quickly in a fast-paced setting. Analytical mindset with focus on measurable results. Nice-to-haves: Background in performance marketing, martech, or adtech. Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools. Knowledge of ethical AI frameworks and regulations. What Makes You Successful Here At Creative Clicks, our top performers: Take initiative and ownership. Focus on solutions, not obstacles. Stay grounded, even under pressure. Collaborate closely with their teams. Continuously deepen their expertise to inspire others. What We Offer A highly dynamic and fast-growing working environment. An international company with more than 25 nationalities. Competitive salary and fully paid commuting expenses. 25 days of annual leave (plus the option to buy 10 more) with a healthy work-life balance and hybrid work setup. A place to learn, discover, and develop yourself. Warm daily lunch in the office. A fun, ambitious, and young team of colleagues. A recently renovated, beautiful office just 2 minutes from Leidseplein in Amsterdam. Creative Clicks is proud to be a diverse and equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Selection decisions are solely based on job-related factors. Apply Now Ready to own AI products that set the trend and push innovation forward? Apply now and join us at Creative Clicks.
